# Data Feed

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:DataFeed`](gmeow-DataFeed.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/DataFeed>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)

A published, ordered stream of items — a syndication feed (RSS/Atom/JSON Feed), a timeline, an activity feed. A specialisation of [`gmeow:Collection`](gmeow-Collection.md); its items ride the universal [`gmeow:hasPart`](../properties/gmeow-hasPart.md) spine and project to [schema:DataFeed](https://schema.org/DataFeed) / dataFeedElement / DataFeedItem.
